title: feat: functional phase 12 android companion
body:
## Summary

Phase 12 replaces the metadata-only Android checkpoint with a bounded, explicit companion path: a real Android project, authenticated local/private transport, strict framed protocol, secure in-memory pairing/session lifecycle, queue/history metadata controls, notification and overlay permission flows, and desktop authority integration. It remains AIP-side and does not import BielOS runtime code.

## Implementation

- Added the Android Gradle project, strict protocol parser/HMAC framing, encrypted Android Keystore storage, explicit-connect client, bounded offline queue/history, and UI controls.
- Added desktop companion transport with one-time pairing, authenticated sessions, replay/nonce/counter protection, bounded frames/payloads, signed responses, revocation/rotation and fail-closed stop lifecycle.
- Added Tauri integration for pairing/session/history/queue operations and a temporary-database localhost authority round trip.
- Added parser, queue, bounded-history, duplex-counter, transport, replay, revocation and stop tests plus Phase 12 documentation alignment.

## Evidence

- Final HEAD: `82ebb6db2bea08f72c65fea03b2b6e7d02fac4f6`; remote branch was created from merged Phase 11 `main` `d0021802288136ffe4da1f3b91356722b015270f` and reverified at the exact SHA.
- Android host gates with repository-local Java 17/SDK/Gradle 8.9: `testDebugUnitTest`, `lintDebug`, and `assembleDebug` passed. Current debug APK SHA-256: `43279D1766096544D8F2799D8C531CC6FC3AF54A95ACE0EFCA0C71CEA8959A0C`.
- Rust host gates passed: fmt check, locked check, clippy with `-D warnings`, and locked tests (`135 passed; 0 failed; 1 ignored`). Contracts typecheck/build/test passed (`19` tests); desktop typecheck/test/build passed (`49` tests); `pnpm secrets:scan` passed (`166` files).
- Distinct Biel4 read-only review: `approved_with_reservations`, no blocking findings. Codex Security diff scan `5a2ccc3c-4f58-4e83-856a-c8094f211f58` for `d002180..82ebb6d`: complete coverage, zero findings.

## Boundaries

This is a functional local/private companion checkpoint, not stable-release approval. Physical-device testing, private-LAN validation, Android permission/overlay/notification UX, real voice/media, recovery, release signing, remote CI and Owner release approval remain pending. Phase 13 gateway work is intentionally separate and unchanged.
